# Sample script

Hi! Today I'll show you how this teleprompter follows your voice and scrolls the text by itself, so you never have to chase it.

**Read a couple of lines**, look into the camera, then glance back at the text. If you slip and start a sentence over, the text jumps back to where that sentence begins.

[Pause, smile] And if you go quiet, the text simply waits for you.

Now try reading this paragraph over the camera, Instagram or TikTok — the prompter keeps listening to you even while you record.
